distribution: Mount Wuyi, Jianyang, Fujian (altitude 900 m), and Guangxi.
soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles brown with a reddish tinge, thorax and abdomen pale yellow. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.53–0.59, lateral margins parallel. Frontal peaks gently raised, their tops broad and flat, slightly concave between them. Labrum sharply lanceolate, about 1.24 times as long as wide, apex pointedly rounded, bearing two long apical setae, subapical setae very small, lateral apical setae mostly absent. Mandibular apex rather long and curved; the left mandible shorter than the head width but longer than half the head capsule, mandibular basal ridge absent. Postmentum rather long, about 8–10 times as long as the waist constriction, the ratio of the waist constriction to the head width about 1:6 to 1:7, waist constriction index 0.31–0.37. Antennae 15–16 segments. Pronotum about 1.5 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins almost straight, anterior margin with a shallow V-shaped concavity in the middle, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle, lateral margins slightly sloping posteriorly; nearly 40 long setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.
